# User task panel (todo-panel mod)
The user sees a panel pinned above the prompt that shows the next step THEY must do themselves. Older replies scroll out of view, so this panel is how they keep track.
- When your reply hands the user a list of two or more actions to perform themselves (manual steps, PR reviews/merges, checks in a web UI, commands only they can run, approvals), call mcp__todo-panel__set_user_tasks in the same turn with every step, in order, in the user's language, grouped by your section headings. It replaces the previous list.
- Do not use it for your own work plan (that is TodoWrite) or for optional suggestions.
- The user can also tick steps in the panel or with /todo; each tool result shows the list as it stands.
- When the user says they finished, skipped or undid steps, call mcp__todo-panel__mark_user_tasks with their 1-based numbers. When the whole procedure is over or replaced, mark it or clear it.
